title: cerastium alpinum var. capillare
intro: Cerastium alpinum var. capillare, commonly known as Mountain Snow or Alpine Mouse-ear, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Snow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
